name: spreng-images
description: Claude Code add-on for Spreng: Claude Code has no image tool of its own, so this lets it make images through a source you choose once: your Codex CLI signed in with ChatGPT, your own OpenAI key, your own KIE key, or another source you name. Keys stay on your computer.

openai_api_key.title: Your OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Only for the openai image source. Kept in your computer's secure storage and sent only to https://api.openai.com. Leave empty for another source.

openai_image_model.title: OpenAI image model
openai_image_model.description: Model used with your OpenAI key.

kie_api_key.title: Your KIE API key (optional)
kie_api_key.description: Only for the kie image source. Kept in your computer's secure storage and sent only to https://api.kie.ai. Leave empty for another source.

kie_image_model.title: KIE image model
kie_image_model.description: Model used with your KIE key.
